"'''Mick'''" was one of the thousands of small, flying [[INS-444 window installation droid]]s on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It worked together with [[CLE-004 window cleaning droid/Legends|CLE-004]], taking instructions from a central computer. Together, the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] replaced the bedroom window of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] Coruscant [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|apartment]] after the original window was destroyed through the actions of [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
